newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares reverse trend on U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares reverse trend on U.S. data.

text.p: 1305 GMT - Shares went into reverse after faster than expected U.S. economic growth stirred fresh international fears of a rise in U.S. interest rates, traders said.
*But some stocks such as pulp group Portucel Industrial and cement firm Cimpor, both of which have been boosted by good industrial fundamentals, remained in positive territory.
*The PSI-20 index was down 0.14 percent at 6,298.41 after having touched a high of 6,345.93.
